5 تخبّط It was, or became, in a state of commotion, agitation, convulsion, tumult, or disturbance; syn. اِضْطَرَبَ. (Az, TA in art. حبط.) ＝
-A2- It is also trans.: see 1; second sentence, in three places; and again, near the end of the paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
